scope: Code/model and synthetic checks; not physical device validation

PASS: all four ages retain independent challenge choices, counting 1–5 persists, malformed/denied storage remains playable, invalid values rejected.

checks.name: every age can select every target 1..30, with enough unique physical stock
wrong total and wrong type are retained for the child to repair
bundling, unbundling, moving, undoing and resetting conserve actual objects
all valid two-truck arrangements are accepted, including mirrored solutions
random input sequences preserve unique objects and never double complete
interrupted delivery and corrupted saves recover without false reward or lockup

limits: Node model checks only. No browser DOM, layout, touch device, TTS listening, or child observation is claimed.

checks.name: newest restore wins when image callbacks finish in reverse order
new paper invalidates a pending restore
a pointer stroke waits for the pending picture and works after restore
destroy invalidates callbacks even if a new lifecycle reuses the canvas
an empty newer restore request cancels the older pending request
ordinary current restore still draws the requested picture

limits: Node callback simulation only; no browser canvas pixels, touch device, or child observation is claimed.

checks.name: save during initial decode preserves the loaded PNG
exit before decode preserves PNG and rejects the late callback
successful restore enables drawing and later saves the actual new stroke
early drawing does not replace the picture still being loaded
decode error keeps the original and offers explicit new-paper recovery
destroy and return with the same canvas cannot revive the old callback
new restore owns saving while older load and error callbacks are ignored
new paper during loading can undo back to the original canonical PNG
empty restore cancels pending work and makes an intentional blank writable
canvas draw failure protects the source just like decode failure
template and mode metadata can still save while free drawing restores
a first visit without a saved drawing stays immediately drawable

limits: Node callback simulation with distinct PNG markers; no actual PNG decoding or browser pixel comparison.
Loading touch is intentionally deferred until restore completes; explicit new paper recovers from a decode failure.

output.suite: Readable stale storage with rejected writes — production closure regressions

checks.name: post office restores the latest three items after an age/range round trip when only writes fail
art restores latest free PNG and per-template coloring when old storage reads succeed but writes fail

limits: Node VM with controlled localStorage behavior; no actual browser quota, private-mode, or device validation.
Memory protects progress within the same loaded page; a real reload cannot recover writes the browser rejected.
